title: Points expiring
description: Advance notice: lots the member holds entered the program's expiry window since the last notice run. Loyalty announces each lot once; `points` is the remaining points of the newly announced lots at notice time, `lots` is those lots, and `earliestExpiresAt` is the soonest of their expiry dates. `noticeDays` is the program's notice window. The event does not change the member's points. The event's `aggregate` is `member/<memberId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

memberId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the member.

externalRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the member, so the Tenant can decide whether and how to tell the member.

points.description: The remaining points of the newly announced lots at notice time.

lots.description: The lots that entered the notice window since the last run, in expiry order.

lotId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the lot.

expiresAt.description: When the lot expires, in UTC.

earliestExpiresAt.description: The soonest expiry among the announced lots, in UTC.

noticeDays.description: The program's notice window in days; a lot is announced when it comes within this many days of expiring.

available.description: The member's available balance at notice time, computed from lots minus debt. The notice itself does not change it.
